verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              अभिषिच्याधिराज्ये तु पृथुं वैन्यं पितामहः। ततः क्रमेण राज्यानि व्यादेष्टुमुपचक्रमे॥१॥
verses.english: And kashyapa gave her that drastic boon saying, "you will bear a son who is capable of eliminating indra, provided you undertake intense ascesis for a hundred year period duly following utmost cleanness..."

verses.sanskrit: द्विजानां वीरुधां चैव नक्षत्रग्रहयोस्तथा। यज्ञानां तपसां चैव सोमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥२॥
verses.english: For all of the fanged reptiles शेष is the numen, while तक्शक is the lord of all the other Reptilia that crawl on their stomach - सरीसृप-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: एवं साधारण्येन सर्वां सृष्टिमुक्त्वा “पृथुर्वैन्यस्तदा चेमां ररक्ष क्षत्त्रपूर्वजः। राजसूयाभिषिक्तानामाद्यः स वसुधाधिपः॥” इति प्रागुक्तं पृथोराद्यत्वं विवृणोति। सर्वेषां राज्यानां तदानन्तर्यं दर्शयन् अभिषिच्येत्यादिना अधिराज्ये राज्ञामपि राजत्वे वैन्यं वेनस्य पुत्रं राज्यानि सोमादीनां व्यादेष्टुमाज्ञापयितुम्॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: अपां तु वरुणं राज्ये राज्ञां वैश्रवणं प्रभुम्। बृहस्पतिं तु विश्वेषां ददावाङ्गिरसं पतिम्॥३॥
verses.english: On constituting पृथु, the son of vena, as the emperor of earth, grandsire brahma then started to constitute - अधिष्टात्र / अधिष्टितात्री देवता - numina, tutelar kings, say presiding deities for certain realms with which they are connected.
verses.bhavadeepa: नक्षत्रग्रहयोः जात्यभिप्रायेण द्विवचनं नक्षत्रजातीयग्रहजातीययोरित्यर्थः। यज्ञानां यज्ञाद्यधिष्ठात्रीणां देवतानाम्॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: भृगूणामधिपं चैव काव्यं राज्येऽभ्यषेहयत्। आदित्यानां तथा विष्णुं वसूनामथ पावकम्॥४॥
verses.english: And that wielder of trident, namely god शिव, is also made the tutelary god of all demiurgic भूता-s and पिशाचा-s; while विप्र-चीति is made as the numen of all दानव-s...

verses.sanskrit: प्रजापतीनां दक्षं तु मरुतामथ वासवम्। दैत्यानां दानवानां च प्रह्लादममितौजसम्॥५॥
verses.english: "oh boy, janamejaya, now I will tell about pR^ithu, the son of vena, in detail... but you listen to it alertly and attentively...

verses.sanskrit: वैवस्वतं च पितॄणां यमं राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्। मातॄणां च व्रतानां च मन्त्राणां च तथा गवाम्॥६॥
verses.english: पर्जन्य is made as the lord of oceans, rivers, rain-clouds and to the radiant sunbeams...

verses.sanskrit: यक्षाणां राक्षसानां च पार्थिवानां तथैव च। नारायणं तु साध्यानां रुद्राणां वृषभध्वजम्॥७॥
verses.english: The son of वैवस्वत्, namely यम, is the numen for manes; and नारायण is the numen of sixteen matriarchal goddesses [षोडश मातृका-s], for व्रता-s [religious observances], for मन्त्रा-s [hymns], cows, yakshA-s, rAkshasA-s, earthly kings, and for deities called साध्या-s... and then, he who got bull as his banner - वृषभ ध्वज - namely god शिव, is made incharge of रुद्रा-s...

verses.sanskrit: विप्रचित्तिं तु राजानं दानवानामथादिशत्। सर्वभूतपिशाचानां गिरिशं शूलपाणिनम्॥८॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fourth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of emperor pR^ithu.

verses.sanskrit: शैलानां हिमवन्तं च नदीनामथ सागरम्। गन्धानां मरुतां चैव भूतानामशरीरिणाम्। शब्दाकाशवतां चैव वायुं च बलिनां वरम्॥९॥
verses.english: हिमालया-s is made as tutelary god for all mountains; ocean for all rivers... and the mightiest of the mighty, vAyu, the airgod, is made as the numen for fragrant materials and their wafters, namely the nineteen marut-s; further, vAyu is the tutelary god for the incorporeal beings existing in thin air, and even for corporeal beings like us...
verses.bhavadeepa: शूलेन पणितुं व्यवहर्तुं शीलमस्येति शूलपाणिः तं शूलपाणिनम्॥८॥

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाणामधिपतिं चक्रे चित्ररथं प्रभुम्। नागानां वासुकिं चक्रे सर्पाणामथ तक्षकम्॥१०॥
verses.english: cइत्र-रथ is the numen of गन्धर्वा-s; multihooded serpent वासुकि for all नागा-s, snakes; many hooded तक्शक for all सर्पा-s, reptiles [नागा-s and सर्पा-s have some difference something like Viperidae and Ophidia suborders..]
verses.bhavadeepa: गन्धानां गन्धाश्रयद्रव्याणां मरुतः पूर्वोक्ता एकोनपञ्चाशत्। अत्र तु प्राणवायवो मरुच्छब्दार्थः। अशरीरिणां स्थूलशरीरहीनानां प्रेतादीनामित्यर्थः। शब्दश्चाकाशश्च तद्वतां भेर्यादीनाम् अस्मदादिशरीराणां च। भुवामिति पाठे तयोः क्षेत्राणामिति स एवार्थः॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: वारणानां च राजानमैरावतमथादिशत्। उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां गरुडं चैव पक्षिणाम्॥११॥
verses.english: "Oh vaishampAyana, please detail about the emergence of emperor pR^ithu, as to how that great man milked the earth...

verses.sanskrit: मृगाणामथ शार्दूलं गोवृषं तु गवां पतिम्। वनस्पतीनां राजानं प्लक्षमेवादिशत् प्रभुम्॥१२॥
verses.english: And lion is the tutelary animal for wild animals; bull for cows; and the प्लक्श tree - the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Infectoria [a large and beautiful tree with small white fruit] is the tutelary tree for वनस्पति trees - trees yielding without blossoms...

verses.sanskrit: सागराणां नदीनां च मेघानां वर्षणस्य च। आदित्यानामधिपतिं पर्जन्यमभिषिक्तवान्॥१३॥
verses.english: पर्जन्य is made as the lord of oceans, rivers, rain-clouds and to the radiant sunbeams...

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषां दंष्ट्रिणां शेषं राजानमभ्यषेचयत्। सरीसॄपानां सर्पाणां राजानं चैव तक्षकम्॥१४॥
verses.english: For all of the fanged reptiles शेष is the numen, while तक्शक is the lord of all the other Reptilia that crawl on their stomach - सरीसृप-s...
verses.bhavadeepa: पूर्वं द्वादशादित्या उक्ताः इह तु आदित्यपदेन अर्कस्य रश्मयो ग्राह्याः। ये पृथिवीरसं शोषयित्वा सहस्रगुणम् उत्सृजन्ति तेषामधिपतिः पर्जन्यः॥१३॥

verses.sanskrit: गन्धर्वाप्सरसां चैव कामदेवं तथा प्रभुम्। ऋतूनामथ मासानां दिवसानां तथैव च॥१५॥
verses.english: Lovegod kAma is made as the numen for gandharvA-s and apsarA-s;
verses.bhavadeepa: दंष्ट्रिणां नागानां सर्पाणां तद्विशेषाणां सरीसृपाणां डुण्डुभादीनां निर्विषाणाम्॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: पक्षाणां च क्षपाणां च मुहूर्ततिथिपर्वणाम्। कलाकाष्ठाप्रमाणानां गतेरयनयोस्तथा॥१६॥
verses.english: And the year, सम्वत्सर, is the numen of all seasons, months, days, fortnights, nights [क्शप], points in time [मुहूर्त], days, junctures of time [पर्व], and for कला, काSःटा, गति, अयन, गणित, योग, करना-s - roughly for the data to calculate of astronomical data and for the movement of southern and northern solstices, eclipses etc...
verses.bhavadeepa: ऋतूनामित्यादिषष्ट्यन्तानां देवतानामित्यनेन सम्बन्धः। ऋत्वाद्याभिमानिनीनां देवतानां संवत्सरं संवत्सराभिमानिनं देवं राजानमभ्यषेचयदित्यर्थः॥१५॥

verses.sanskrit: गणितस्याथ योगस्य चक्रे संवत्सरं प्रभुम्। एवं विभज्य राज्यानि क्रमेण स पितामहः॥१७॥
verses.english: On earmarking domains in this way, then the grandsire brahma sequentially started to establish the custodians of directions - दिक् पाला-s...

verses.sanskrit: दिशापालानथ ततः स्थापयामास भारत। पूर्वस्यां दिशि पुत्रं तु वैराजस्य प्रजापतेः॥१८॥
verses.english: Thus, सुधन्व, the son of वैराज प्रजापति, is assigned for the eastern quarter; शङ्खपद, the son of कर्दम प्रजापति, for the south; likewise, the son of रजस्, namely केतुमन्त, for the west; and हिरण्य-रोम, the son of पर्जन्य प्रजपति, is established as the tutelary custodian of the northern direction...

verses.sanskrit: दिशापालं सुधन्वानं राजानं चाभ्यषेचयत्। दक्षिणस्यां महात्मानं कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः॥१९॥
verses.english: And even today, those custodians of directions are dutifully safeguarding all of the earth with seven continents and mountains, together with their neighborhoods...

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रं शङ्खपदं नाम राजानं सोऽभ्यषेचयत्। पश्चिमायां दिशि तथा रजसः पुत्रमच्युतम्॥२०॥
verses.english: And oh, king janamejaya, these regents, from सोम to पर्जन्य, have anointed पृथु as emperor in a राजसूय याग, as has been enshrined in scriptures like Veda-s etc...

verses.sanskrit: केतुमन्तं महात्मानं राजानं सोऽभ्यषेचयत्। तथा हिरण्यरोमाणं पर्जन्यस्य प्रजापतेः॥२१॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the third chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of marut-gaNA-s, the Wind-gods.

verses.sanskrit: उदीच्यां दिशि दुर्धर्षं राजानं सोऽभ्यषेचयत्। तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सप्तद्वीपा सपर्वता॥२२॥
verses.english: If you to wish to continue faithful listening to these solemn and auspicious legends that are enshrined in purANA-s, and that enrich one's own renown, and that ensures a place in heaven, I will continue further narration...

verses.sanskrit: यथाप्रदेशमद्यापि धर्मेण परिपाल्यते। राजसूयाभिषिक्तस्तु पृथुरेभिर्नराधिपैः। वेददृष्टेन विधिना राजाराज्ये नराधिप॥२३॥
verses.english: "Oh vaishampAyana, please detail about the emergence of emperor pR^ithu, as to how that great man milked the earth...

verses.sanskrit: ततो मन्वन्तरेऽतीते चाक्षुषेऽमिततेजसि। वैवस्वताय मनवे ब्रह्मा राज्यमथादिशत्। तस्य विस्तरमाख्यास्ये मनोर्वैवस्वतस्य ह॥२४॥
verses.english: Later, when the मन्वन्तर, era, of highly resplendent cआक्शुष मनु, called cआक्शुष-मन्वन्तरम्, has ended, grandsire brahma has made वैवस्वत मनु as the sovereign of earth, whereby that era, मन्वन्तरम्, is called वैवस्वत मन्वन्तरम्...
verses.bhavadeepa: अद्यापीत्येतासां देवतानामधिकारित्वेनाकल्पस्थायित्वमुक्तं- राजेति। एभिः सोमादिभिः पृथुः राजराज्ये राजसूयेऽभिषिक्तः पूर्वं तु  प्रजापतिनाऽभिषेको राज्याङ्गः उक्तः॥२३॥

verses.sanskrit: तवानुकूल्याद्राजेन्द्र यदि शुश्रूषसेऽनघ। महद्ध्येतदधिष्ठानं पुराणं परिकीर्तितम्। धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं स्वर्गवासकरं शुभम्॥२५॥
verses.english: If you to wish to continue faithful listening to these solemn and auspicious legends that are enshrined in purANA-s, and that enrich one's own renown, and that ensures a place in heaven, I will continue further narration...

verses.sanskrit:
जनमेजय उवाच।
              विस्तरेण पृथोर्जन्म वैशम्पायन कीर्तय। यथा महात्मना तेन दुग्धा चेयं वसुन्धरा॥२६॥
verses.english: What type of milking vessels they handled... which kind of calves they used... what is the milk they obtained... who milked what... furthermore, what is the reason for those great sages to become infuriated, whereby they churned the palms of vena, the father of emperor pR^ithu...

verses.sanskrit: यथा च पितृभिर्दुग्धा यथा देवैर्यथर्षिभिः। यथा दैत्यैश्च नागैश्च यथा यक्षैर्यथा द्रुमैः॥२७॥
verses.english: "oh boy, janamejaya, now I will tell about pR^ithu, the son of vena, in detail... but you listen to it alertly and attentively...

verses.sanskrit: यथा शैलैः पिशाचैश्च गन्धर्वैश्च द्विजोत्तमैः। राक्षसैश्च महासत्त्वैर्यथा दुग्धा वसुन्धरा॥२८॥
verses.english: This narration, oh, king, is not aimed at one who is impure, malevolent, a depraved student, faithless, and an unworthy...

verses.sanskrit: तेषां पात्रविशेषांश्च वैशम्पायन कीर्तय। वत्सान्क्षीरविशेषांश्च दोग्धारं चानुपूर्वशः॥२९॥
verses.english: Now you may detailedly listen to this episode of pR^ithu, the son of vena, listening which enables a way to heavens, enriches renown and longevity, accords merit, and which is in accordance of Vedic sayings... and he who listens this after revering brAhmaNA-s will not reflect upon the rights and wrongs of his actions... i.e., he neither thinks that he has done some wrongs, nor elevate himself thinking what all he has done is right... but, affirms himself that he has done his duty...

verses.sanskrit: यस्माच्च कारणात्पाणिर्वेनस्य मथितः पुरा। क्रुद्धैर्महर्षिभिस्तात कारणं तच्च कीर्तय॥३०॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the fourth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of emperor pR^ithu.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि पृथोर्वैन्यस्य विस्तरम्। एकाग्रः प्रयतश्चैव शृणुष्व जनमेजय॥३१॥
नाशुचेः क्षुद्रमनसः कुशिष्यायाव्रताय च। कीर्तनीयमिमं राजन्कृतघ्नायाहिताय च॥३२॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the third chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the emergence of marut-gaNA-s, the Wind-gods.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं धर्म्यं वेदेन सम्मितम्। रहस्यमृषिभिः प्रोक्तं शृणु राजन्यथातथम्॥३३॥
यश्चैनं कथयेन्नित्यं पृथोर्वैन्यस्य विस्तरम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नमस्कृत्य न स शोचेत्कृताकृतैः॥३४॥
